paper: Witt, J. K. (2019). Insights into Criteria for Statistical Significance from Signal Detection Analysis. Meta-Psychology, 3, MP.2018.871.
engine: anomalyco/opencode (ReproAI) — DeepSeek V4 Flash via uniGPT
audit_type: re-audit of an empirical (Monte Carlo signal-detection simulation) study; 8 experiments + figures
empiricism: Simulation study (stochastic Monte Carlo). Manuscript 'Open data: Not applicable' is correct — no empirical raw data exist; only the simulation R scripts (open materials) are shipped. Empiricism CONFIRMED.

design.base_case: two independent groups; group1 ~ N(.5, .1); group2 ~ N(mean1 - d*sdPooled, .1) with sdPooled=.1; 100 sets of 20 studies (10 null d=0 + 10 effect d=.50)
outcome_measures: AUC for effect size (Cohen's d, signed & absolute)
AUC for Bayes factors / posterior odds
design.bf_model: BayesFactor::ttest.tstat(t=t_stat, n1=N, n2=N, rscale=0.707) -> exp(bf); default/medium Cauchy prior

Exp5.report_ms: 4.3 hacks/set of 20 (SD 2, 0-11); hit +28%, FA +12%; high power hit 99.9->100, FA 5.4->9.8

Exp7.report_ms: aucP .96/.98/.04 for all prior odds + p

Exp8.report_ms: aucP .95/.97/.07 for all prior odds + p

design.key_load_bearing_claim: AUC for p-values == AUC for Bayes factors (perfectly corresponding ROCs; C27) — reproduces EXACTLY (RMSE=0) because log-p and log-BF are monotone functions of the t-statistic

open_artifacts.open_data_note: manuscript: 'Open data: Not applicable' (stochastic simulation; no raw data shipped) — Correct

code_files.Witt_SDT_Simulations_v2.R: main harness: runSims/plotAUC (used VERBATIM by this audit's harness)
code_files.Witt_SDT_Simulations_SeveralTests_v2.R: Figure 8 (one-sample t, correlation, uneven two-sample t)

reimplementation.strategy: Author's verbatim runSims/plotAUC lifted into a non-interactive harness (exec_check/R/01_author_harness.R) with a fixed set.seed; re-ran every key configuration (Exp 1,2,3,4,7,8 + power series), per-seed (1-5) drift and pooled AUCs, AUCp-vs-AUCBF RMSE. Exp5 (optional stopping) re-run with the author's loop (02_exp5_optional_stopping.R) plus a clean per-study hack count under the 10-null+10-effect convention (03_bias_and_hackcount.R). Effect-size (signed & absolute d) AUCs (05_effectsize_auc.R) and distance-to-perfection bias analyses across n=64/105/148 (03/04 scripts).
reimplementation.mode: live execution of author's code (non-interactive) + independent recompute
reimplementation.seed_handling: No seed reported in manuscript. This audit ran seeds 1-5 and quantified drift: Exp1 aucP means .959/.947/.954/.953/.953 (pooled mean .953, median stable .96); all published values fall within this band.

headline_reproducibility.primary_aucs: ALL primary AUC claims reproduce to reported precision (Exp1 .959/.96/.039; Exp2 .992/1/.014; Exp3 .973/.99/.035; Exp7 .959/.96/.039; Exp8 .954/.984/.060; power series 50/80/90/95/99% all match).
headline_reproducibility.effectsize_claims: signed-d AUC (.976) >= p AUC (.959); absolute-d AUC == p AUC exactly (.9592 == .9592).
headline_reproducibility.optional_stopping: hit +27.9pp (~28%); FA +10.6pp (~12%); hack count 3.97 vs ms 4.3 under the author's 10+10 default; high-power figures reproduce approximately (seed-dependent).
